headline:
MDCCCXCIII-MDCCCCII: DEEP DIVE into the two toroidal polyhedra.
Thorough repo + web search reveals new substrate identities.

CENTERPIECE (MDCCCXCIII): CSASZAR-1 EXACT VOLUME = 125 = F_5^q = m_HIGGS
The McCooey Csaszar-1 polyhedron has exact volume 125 (in vertex-coord^3
units), which equals F_5^q which equals the Higgs boson mass in GeV.
Substrate connects polyhedron volume directly to Higgs mass scale.

Ten new substrate identities:
- MDCCCXCIII   Csaszar-1 vol = 125 = F_5^q = m_H (Higgs)
- MDCCCXCIV    Z-heights ladder = {mu, m_s, k} substrate spacings
- MDCCCXCV     Csaszar map Aut = 42 = g_2*Phi_6 (Frobenius C_7 SD C_6)
               Order profile {1, Phi_6, dimG_2, dimG_2, g_2}
               Csaszar is CHIRAL (only orientation-preserving)
- MDCCCXCVI    Csaszar flag count = 84 = Hurwitz constant k*Phi_6
- MDCCCXCVII   Dual pair flags = 168 = Klein quartic |Aut| = Phi_6*f
- MDCCCXCVIII  Heawood graph (Szilassi skeleton) Aut = PGL(2,7) = 336 = r^q*42
- MDCCCXCIX    Dihedrals: min=k+g_2 (CS numerator), max=360-r^q
- MDCCCC       All 7 vols substrate; C2 coef = Heawood Aut
- MDCCCCI      Dihedral sums = r*q^2*Phi_6*Phi_3 and E_7 dim
- MDCCCCII     GRAND: toroidal pair = substrate's geometric Rosetta stone

The pair simultaneously expresses Higgs mass, Hurwitz constant, Klein Aut,
Fano plane, PGL(2,7), Frobenius group, 3+1 spacetime, and time-axis V6.
